biggest_catch: Rates are set per brand and you earn only on sales you drive — zero guaranteed campaigns — and the headline bonuses require $17,000–$42,500 in monthly commissions.
catches: ZERO GUARANTEED EARNINGS: you earn only when your audience shops through your SmartLinks or you are selected for brand campaigns; no guaranteed income, campaigns, or sales.

BRAND-SELECTION RISK: brand campaigns and campaign fees are at the brands' discretion; Mavely's official FAQ lists affiliate links, brand campaigns, monthly bonuses, and referral commission as the earning paths.
VARIABLE PAY: commission rates are set per brand and shown on Mavely rate cards — Mavely passes the full rate through but does not set a guaranteed rate for you.
CONTENT RIGHTS: you create shoppable content and posts; exact content-usage and rights terms for brand campaigns are in Mavely's creator agreement — read them before participating.

Bonus tiers are volume-based: $17,000 in monthly commissions = $4,000 bonus; $27,000 = $6,000 bonus; $42,500 = $10,000 bonus — paid 30 days after the end of each calendar month, separately from standard commission payments.
Standard commission payout cadence is not stated on the cited official pages — confirm the current payout schedule in your Mavely account.

steps: Sign up as a creator on Mavely (joinmavely.com) and verify your account — no fee or application, and no minimum following required.
Create shoppable SmartLinks for products from participating brands and share them on your social accounts, blog, newsletter, or link-in-bio.
When your audience shops through your links, you earn the brand's commission rate in full — what you see on Mavely's rate cards is what lands in your wallet.
Pursue brand campaigns and referral commission as additional earning paths listed in Mavely's official FAQ.
Track your monthly commissions on the Live Bonus Tracker in the Mavely app or desktop dashboard.

If your monthly commissions hit a bonus tier ($17,000 / $27,000 / $42,500), the corresponding bonus ($4,000 / $6,000 / $10,000) is paid automatically — no opt-in needed — 30 days after the end of that calendar month.
